description: This file defines a custom exception class named ServiceException used for handling service-related errors within the application. It includes various constructors for different error scenarios, exception type constants, and a message code field for additional error identification.

classes.name: ServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for representing errors generated by the application's services, with additional context such as exception type and message code.

methods.name: setMessageCode
methods.description: Sets the message code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getMessageCode
methods.description: Retrieves the message code associated with this exception.

methods.name: getExceptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the exception.

methods.name: setExceptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the exception.
